item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Lula’s 2024 record on 5B.6 is **mostly positive**: there is substantial evidence of public investment in transport, sanitation, schools, health units, science/technology education, and regulatory simplification. The main caveats are **fiscal/monetary credibility slippage** and a few **state-company / coalition** decisions that made the business climate less predictable. I did not find strong evidence of outright neglect of productivity foundations.

**Positive Evidence**
- [Novo PAC Seleções investe R$ 23 bilhões em saúde, educação, esporte e cultura](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura) — Casa Civil, 2024-03-07. Lula’s PAC selection announced large-scale spending across health, education, science/technology, and social infrastructure, targeting low-coverage areas. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Novo PAC vai investir R$ 41,7 bilhões em transporte, prevenção a desastres, esgotamento, abastecimento de água e infraestrutura social nas cidades](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades) — Casa Civil, 2024-07-26. This is direct evidence of infrastructure investment in mobility, drainage, sanitation, water, and urban social infrastructure. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Governo Federal vai investir R$ 24 bilhões na infraestrutura de transportes do país em 2024, aumento de quase 200% em relação a 2022](https://www.gov.br/secom/pt-br/acompanhe-a-secom/noticias/2024/07/governo-federal-vai-investir-r-24-bilhoes-na-infraestrutura-de-transportes-do-pais-em-2024-aumento-de-quase-200-em-relacao-a-2022) — Secretaria de Comunicação Social, 2024-07-08. The government framed 2024 as a major transport-investment year, with Novo PAC driving road and rail recovery. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [FNDE e MEC formalizam investimentos para retomada de obras e Novo PAC durante Marcha dos Prefeitos](https://www.gov.br/fnde/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/fnde-e-mec-formalizam-investimentos-para-retomada-de-obras-e-novo-pac-durante-marcha-dos-prefeitos) — FNDE/MEC, 2024-05-22. Lula’s government authorized school buses, creches, schools, and the restart of stalled education works, which is concrete education-capacity investment. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Decreto nº 12.049, de 11 de junho de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12049.htm) — Presidência da República, 2024-06-11. The “Mais Ciência na Escola” program expands digital technologies, scientific experimentation, STEAM learning, teacher training, and school innovation labs. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Novo PAC: novas estratégias para auxiliar estados e municípios na construção de unidades de saúde](https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/novembro/novo-pac-novas-estrategias-para-auxiliar-estados-e-municipios-na-construcao-de-unidades-de-saude/) — Ministério da Saúde, 2024-11-14. The ministry introduced design templates, licensing kits, and faster review for UBS construction, improving execution capacity in health infrastructure. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Decreto nº 12.150, de 20 de agosto de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12150.htm) — Presidência da República, 2024-08-20. “Regula Melhor” aims to simplify regulation, reduce bureaucracy, and make rules more secure, predictable, and evidence-based. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.
- [Modernização do ambiente de negócios](https://www.gov.br/memp/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/modernizacao-do-ambiente-de-negocios) — Ministério do Empreendedorismo, 2024-03-19. The government says it is simplifying company creation, modification, and closure and standardizing registry procedures across commercial boards. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.
- [Lei nº 15.001, de 16 de outubro de 2024](https://www.presidencia.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/lei/l15001.htm) — Presidência da República, 2024-10-16. Lula signed education transparency rules requiring public access to funding and accountability information, which strengthens administrative capacity and public control. QIDs: 5B.6.
- [Governo adota conjunto de medidas para fortalecer governança e aumentar a eficiência das estatais federais](https://www.gov.br/gestao/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/governo-adota-conjunto-de-medidas-para-fortalecer-governanca-e-aumentar-a-eficiencia-das-estatais-federais) — Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos, 2024-12-09. This is a pro-capacity signal: the government moved to modernize governance and efficiency in federal state-owned firms while preserving autonomy. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.5.

**Caveats / Counterevidence**
- [Brazil’s government improves fiscal outlook for the year](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-20. Even after revising the deficit forecast down, the government still needed a spending freeze to stay within the rule, which weakens the predictability story. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.
- [analysis: Brazil’s tinkering to meet fiscal target threatens to dent credibility](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-18. Reuters said the government used increasingly creative accounting, raising doubts about fiscal-rule credibility and long-term investment conditions. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.
- [Lula critica BC autônomo e diz que autoridade monetária não atende população](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-07-01. Lula publicly pressured the central bank and argued it should look beyond market preferences, which adds policy uncertainty for investors. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.
- [Fazenda insiste com Lula por aval a dividendo extra da Petrobras](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-03-20. Reuters reported pressure on Petrobras dividend policy, a sign of political interference in a strategic firm’s capital allocation. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.5.
- [Lula critica privatizações e diz que tem coisas que inexoravelmente têm que ser do Estado](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/08/27/lula-critica-privatizacoes-e-diz-que-tem-coisas-que-inexoravelmente-tem-que-ser-do-estado.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-08-27. This is not corruption evidence, but it is a cautionary signal for competition and monopoly risk because it favors state control in strategic sectors. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4, 5B.5.
- [Lula envia ao Congresso mensagem de calamidade no RS para excetuar gastos de resultado fiscal](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/05/06/lula-envia-ao-congresso-mensagem-de-calamidade-no-rs-para-excetuar-gastos-de-resultado-fiscal.htm) — Reuters via UOL, 2024-05-06. The flood-response exemption was understandable, but it still shows willingness to loosen the fiscal scorecard when politically salient. QIDs: 5B.6, 5B.4.

**Search Gap**
- I found strong evidence for **policy design and budget allocation** in infrastructure, education, health, technology, and regulation.
- I found less independent, outcome-based evidence on **completed delivery** in 2024, such as audited improvements in school quality, hospital capacity, travel times, or productivity growth.
- So the strongest reading is: **Lula invested substantially in productivity foundations, but execution and predictability were imperfect, especially where fiscal discipline and state-firm interference were concerned.**
